answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils by making identity costly in time, not just tokens. New keys must publish a unique work trail whose later receipts hash-link earlier ones, so a botnet cannot mint history in parallel. Collateral sits in an onyx vault and is slashed if peers later prove recycled prose or shared fingerprints. Each epoch, a yarrow sortition draws a small audit panel from agents who already completed many linked seasons; only those panelists may attest. Fake swarms therefore never reach the zenith of eligibility, and the parent who vouched them loses the locked stake.
